evidence.quote: A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

observations.why: Flat descriptive assertion of what the note is for — asserted and ready to stand on, but no ratification or permanence language to lift it to decision or principle.

evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Stated as a constitutive distinction — categorical, identity-level, no hedging; the sentence form itself ('is not the same as') presents the distinction as bedrock the speaker treats as foundational.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Categorical, creed-like assertion of what the durable asset is — permanence language ('the asset you keep') signals identity-level conviction, not a moveable claim.

evidence.quote:
This restates the individually-owned-intelligence thesis so a navigating
extractor has existing positioning to connect to.

observations.why: Descriptive self-report of what the text does — asserted plainly but functionally, without the creed-like permanence that lifts src-2 and src-3 to principle; a claim about the document's own purpose.
